description: `review_focus.csv` = unknown-player listings (`pilot_player_status` unknown). **Excludes** lot/pick/set-builder/complete-set/presale/graded (same as `row_excluded_from_listing_counts`). `review_unclassified.csv` still lists all unknown rows without those filters. Sort: price ascending then title. Set **`review_focus_scope`: `all`** for the full scored pool. Fast refresh: `python3 -m cardmatch --input pilot_scored_full.csv --review-focus-only --output-dir <dir>`.
